title: Kathy A Probable NDE 3411
content: I was forty-one and had my third child. After the baby was born, I was diagnosed with an arteriovenous malformation in my brain. I had to go through three separate embolization and after that, I was to have brain surgery. I really didn't think about the actual surgery, I just knew I wanted this thing out of my head. When I awoke from the surgery I began telling my mother that I had been on a path made of light that was what appeared to be a night sky with stars all around. The path zigzagged and at the end of the path, I could see a very bright light. I remember just standing in the path and a small girl who was as if bright light was standing next to me and a very tall man dressed in a green suit. In front of me were three beings dressed in black robes that had emeralds around their hoods. I could not see their faces and I was not afraid. I felt very calm and peaceful. They spoke to me with their minds and told me that it was not my time yet. That I had to go back and love Him. I did not understand what that meant. When I described the little girl in the bright light, my mother's face just went white. She later told me that I had described my grandmother when she was about twelve years old. That white light remained very close to me even after I woke up. I kept pointing to her and telling my family that she was right next to me protecting me. After I got home from hospital, I continued to see other dead relatives in my home and was very tuned into other people's feelings. It was not until I had to go to therapy during my recovery that my therapist, who is Jewish, helped me realize the three beings were the Trinity and that I had to go back and love Him, was God. From that love, love just flowed out of me. It took me two and half years to recover from brain surgery and the whole time I was very close to God. Since I have been back to work, I don't have that love and peacefulness that I once had and I desperately want those feelings back!

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A zigzagging path made of light in what appeared to be a night sky with stars all around, with a very bright light at the end.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Therapist later suggested the three beings were the Trinity; told to go back and love Him (understood as God).
arrival.other_being_detail: Three beings in black robes with emeralds around their hoods; faces not visible. A small girl 'as if bright light' and a very tall man in a green suit.

environment.environment_other_detail: Night-sky-like setting with stars all around; a path of light leading to a very bright light.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told it was not her time and that she had to go back and 'love Him' (later understood as God).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Brain surgery following diagnosis of an arteriovenous malformation (after three embolizations).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Post-hospital: continued seeing dead relatives at home; felt the 'white light' girl remained close and protective even after waking.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No out-of-body observation described; experience centers on a light-path setting with beings and a message to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The bright 'little girl' presence was perceived as remaining close even after awakening; continued seeing other dead relatives at home after discharge.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “They spoke to me with their minds and told me that it was not my time yet. That I had to go back and love Him.”
